stem.en: According to the Higgs mechanism, why do the W and Z bosons have mass while the photon does not?
stem.et: Higgsi mehhanismi kohaselt, miks on W ja Z bosonitel mass, kuid footonil mitte?

label.en: The W and Z bosons interact with the ever-present, nonzero Higgs field in a way the photon does not, acquiring mass through that interaction while the photon remains massless.
label.et: W ja Z bosonid interakteeruvad alati kohalviibiva, nullist erineva Higgsi väljaga viisil, mida footon ei tee, omandades selle interaktsiooni kaudu massi, samal ajal kui footon jääb massituks.

label.en: The Higgs mechanism actually gives mass to every Standard Model particle equally, including the photon, just by a smaller amount.
label.et: Higgsi mehhanism annab tegelikult massi igale standardmudeli osakesele võrdselt, kaasa arvatud footonile, lihtsalt väiksemas koguses.

label.en: The gauge symmetry underlying the weak force was simply broken and removed from the theory for the W and Z, but kept intact for the photon.
label.et: Nõrga jõu aluseks olev kalibratsioonisümmeetria lihtsalt murti ja eemaldati teooriast W ja Z jaoks, kuid jäeti footoni jaoks puutumatuks.

label.en: The Higgs field is just ordinary empty space, so this has nothing to do with the Higgs mechanism at all — the mass difference must come from somewhere else entirely.
label.et: Higgsi väli on lihtsalt tavaline tühi ruum, nii et sellel pole Higgsi mehhanismiga üldse mingit pistmist — massierinevus peab tulema hoopis kusagilt mujalt.
